verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say it supports creating and tracking SLOs, and that real-user monitoring and synthetic tests feed into them. Error budgets and burn-rate alerts, the other core parts of the story, are not covered; the general alerting evidence is only threshold and KQL rules. Missing for 10: documented error-budget tracking, burn-rate alert rules on SLOs, in-depth SLO configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts

citations.quote: Elastic Observability allows for creating and tracking SLOs to ensure you meet your performance targets.
Real user monitoring and synthetic testing are tied to SLOs and back end telemetry.
